snippet.title: SUZURI (1997) by Kenta Cho (ABA Games)
snippet.description:
SUZURI (1997) by Kenta Cho @abagames: control a red ink stroke and manoeuvre it amongst appearing black ink kanji & calligraphy. Use the mouse to move up/down, speed/slow, or retreat a little. Part of the stage design is reminiscent of Flappy Bird (2013).

https://www.asahi-net.or.jp/~cs8k-cyu/free/suzuri.html
